product_metadata.title: 12 x 9cm Baby Pink / Blush Pink Glitter + Matt Droplet Christmas Tree Ornaments
features: Each droplet measures approx 9cm long and 1.5cm wide.
You could even make a garland by threading them through a piece of string.
description: These are lovely decorations for putting on a Christmas tree instead of standard Christmas tree baubles. They would also look great along side ordinary baubles. They have thread already attached for putting on the tree. You could even put them on a piece of string to make a garland. Each droplet measures approx 9cm long and 1.5cm wide. The decorations are a mixture of glitter and matt finish. The decorations have a silver top with silver thread.
